<#
  BlueStick client report — executive brief.

  For leadership: what was assessed, what was found, how serious it is, and
  what to do about each finding.  It deliberately leaves out evidence, steps
  to reproduce and host lists — those are in the Penetration test report,
  which the same draft can switch to at any time (Reports → the draft →
  Template).

  The same data as every template (see sample-data.json) and the same rules
  as report-templates/pentest/report.qmd, whose header comment explains the
  delimiters and the helpers (md, todo, asset, plain).  In short: a printed
  value is escaped, written Markdown only through md(), and never any data in
  the YAML front matter — bluestick-meta names the data instead.
#>
---
title: "Security assessment brief"
bluestick-meta:
  title: report.title
  subtitle: report.heading
date: << plain(report.date) >>
engine: markdown
filters:
  - quarto
  - _bluestick/fields.lua
format:
  html:
    theme: cosmo
    fontsize: 11pt
    page-layout: article
    embed-resources: true
    include-in-header:
      - text: |
          <style>
          table { width: 100%; }
          td, th { vertical-align: top; }
          img.bs-logo { border: none; padding: 0; max-width: 2in; height: auto; }
          mark.bs-todo { background: #ffe066; color: #1a1a1a; padding: 0 .25em; }
          </style>
<% if asset("logo") %>
    include-before-body:
      - text: |
          <p class="bs-logo-wrap"><img class="bs-logo" src="<< asset("logo") >>" alt="Logo"></p>
<% endif %>
  docx:
    reference-doc: reference.docx
---

<% if report.draft %>
::: {.callout-warning}
**Draft** — built from the live findings on << plain(report.date) >>. Not for distribution. Search for **TODO** to find what is still missing.
:::

<% endif %>
{{< pagebreak >}}

| | |
|:---------------|:--|
| Client | << engagement.client_name or todo("Client name") >> |
| Assessment | << project.name >><% if engagement.engagement_type %> — << engagement.engagement_type >><% endif %> |
| Dates | <% if project.start_date and project.end_date %><< project.start_date >> to << project.end_date >><% else %><< todo("Set the project's start and end dates") >><% endif %> |
| Classification | << engagement.classification or todo("Classification") >> |
| Report | << report.title >><% if report.number %> (report << report.number >>)<% endif %> |

<% if report.kind == "addendum" %>
<# An addendum is the changes table and nothing else: leadership wants to know
   what moved, and the Penetration test report carries the detail. #>
<% set new = findings|selectattr("change", "equalto", "new")|list %>
<% set grown = findings|selectattr("change", "equalto", "new_hosts")|list %>
# What changed since report << report.baseline.number >>

<< md("executive_summary", todo="Summarise what changed since the last report, and what it means.") >>

<% if new or grown or delta.withdrawn %>
| Change | Ref | Finding | Severity |
|:---------------------|:------|:---------------------------------------------|:-----------|
<% for f in new %>
| New finding | << f.ref >> | << f.title >> | << f.severity_label >> |
<% endfor %>
<% for f in grown %>
| Found on << f.new_affected|length >> more system(s) | << f.ref >> | << f.title >> | << f.severity_label >> |
<% endfor %>
<% for w in delta.withdrawn %>
| Withdrawn | << w.ref >> | << w.title >> | << w.severity_label >> |
<% endfor %>
<% else %>
Nothing has changed since report << report.baseline.number >>.
<% endif %>
<% else %>
# Summary

<< md("executive_summary", todo="Write the summary: what was assessed, what was found, and what to do first.") >>

# Findings at a glance

| Critical | High | Medium | Low | Informational |
|:------------:|:------------:|:------------:|:------------:|:----------------:|
| << counts.critical >> | << counts.high >> | << counts.medium >> | << counts.low >> | << counts.info >> |

<% set actionable = findings|rejectattr("severity", "equalto", "info")|list %>
<% if actionable %>

| Ref | Finding | Severity | Systems | Status |
|:------|:---------------------------------------------|:-----------|:--------|:----------------------|
<% for f in actionable %>
| << f.ref >> | << f.title >> | << f.severity_label >> | << f.affected_count >> | << f.status_note or "Confirmed" >> |
<% endfor %>
<% else %>
No findings above informational severity.
<% endif %>

# Scope

<% if scope.subnets or scope.domains %>
<% if scope.subnets %>
<< scope.subnets|length >> network(s): << scope.subnets|map(attribute="cidr")|join(", ") >>.
<% endif %>
<% if scope.domains %>
<< scope.domains|length >> domain(s): << scope.domains|map(attribute="domain")|join(", ") >>.
<% endif %>
<% else %>
<< todo("No scope is recorded — define the project's scoped networks and domains", block=True) >>
<% endif %>

# What to do

<% for f in actionable %>
## << f.ref >> — << f.title >> (<< f.severity_label >>)

<% if f.status_note %>
*<< f.status_note >>.*

<% endif %>
<< md(f, "recommendation", todo="Say what to change to fix it.") >>

<% else %>
Nothing to action above informational severity.
<% endfor %>
<% endif %>

---

*A security assessment is a point-in-time analysis of the systems tested during the dates above. The full report, with evidence and affected systems for every finding, is available on request.*
